settings.label: Settings
settings.description: CraftEngine item settings (Tags, Fuel Time, Repair …)

settingsTags.label: Tags
settingsTags.description: Item tags the item belongs to, e.g. for recipes.

settingsFuelTime.label: Fuel Time
settingsFuelTime.description: How long the item burns as furnace fuel, in ticks.

settingsFuelRemainder.label: Fuel Remainder
settingsFuelRemainder.description: The item left in the furnace after burning. Only for items that do not stack.

settingsBreakPower.label: Break Power
settingsBreakPower.description: Mining level of the tool. Blocks with a required break power need at least this value.

settingsRepairable.label: Repairable
settingsRepairable.description: Whether the item can be repaired in a crafting table, anvil or grindstone: everywhere at once, or per place.

craftingTable.label: Combine two in a crafting table

anvilRepair.label: Repair with materials in an anvil

settingsAnvilRepairItem.label: Anvil Repair Item
settingsAnvilRepairItem.description: Set on a repair material: the items it repairs in an anvil.

settingsDragRepairItem.label: Drag Repair Item
settingsDragRepairItem.description: Set on a repair material: the items it repairs when dropped onto them in the inventory.

settingsAnvilRepairMaterial.label: Anvil Repair Material
settingsAnvilRepairMaterial.description: Set on the item being repaired: the materials that repair it in an anvil. Documented for CraftEngine versions after 26.9; 26.9 ignores it.

settingsDragRepairMaterial.label: Drag Repair Material
settingsDragRepairMaterial.description: Set on the item being repaired: the materials that repair it when dropped onto it in the inventory. Documented for CraftEngine versions after 26.9; 26.9 ignores it.

settingsRespectRepairableComponent.label: Respect Repairable Component
settingsRespectRepairableComponent.description: The anvil follows the vanilla repairable component of the item.

settingsRenameable.label: Renameable
settingsRenameable.description: Whether the item can be renamed in an anvil.

settingsEnchantable.label: Enchantable
settingsEnchantable.description: Whether the item can be used in an enchanting table.

settingsPreventBreak.label: Prevent Break
settingsPreventBreak.description: The item keeps its last durability point instead of breaking.

settingsCanPlace.label: Can Place
settingsCanPlace.description: Whether the vanilla block of the material can be placed.

settingsDisableVanillaBehavior.label: Disable Vanilla Behavior
settingsDisableVanillaBehavior.description: Turns off what the vanilla material does when used, e.g. placing its block. Read by CraftEngine 26.9, not documented on the wiki.

settingsDyeable.label: Dyeable
settingsDyeable.description: Whether the item can be dyed in a crafting table.

settingsDyeColor.label: Dye Color
settingsDyeColor.description: The color the item adds in dye recipes, as r,g,b.

settingsFireworkColor.label: Firework Color
settingsFireworkColor.description: The color the item adds to a firework star fade, as r,g,b.

settingsEquipment.label: Equipment
settingsEquipment.description: Applies a CraftEngine equipment definition when the item is worn.

damageOnHurt.label: Takes damage when the wearer is hit

equipOnInteract.label: Can be put on a mob by using it

armor.label: CustomArmor (Armor, Elytra, Mob Armor, Harness, Saddles)
armor.description: Texture shown when worn: player armor, elytra wings, armor for wolf/horse/llama/nautilus, harness for the happy ghast, or saddles. ResourcepackBuilder generates an equipment model in the pack and an entry in equipments.yml from it, and sets settings.equipment (equipment ID and, without an armor material, the slot).
armor.hint: All parts of a set get the same set ID; the textures only need to be uploaded on one part. Elytras, animal armor and saddles each need their own set ID. CraftEngine has no allowed animals: animal armor fits any animal with that slot.

type.label: Equipment type
type.help: Component works from 1.21.2 on. Trim also works from 1.20 on but only uses player armor (layer 1 and 2), and the item can take no other trim.

humanoidBaby.label: Player: Baby layer (26.1+)
humanoidBaby.help: Armor as worn by baby zombies and other baby humanoids.

elytra.label: Elytra wings
elytra.help: Like elytra.png. Without material ELYTRA, ResourcepackBuilder adds the glider component automatically.

saddles.label: Saddles (1.21.5+)
saddles.help: A saddle can have textures for several animals.

overlays.label: Overlay textures
overlays.help: A second texture drawn over the layer. It keeps its colors on dyeable armor, e.g. for buckles or gems.

dyeable.label: Dyeable
dyeable.help: The layers take the item’s dye color, like leather armor. The item needs a dye color itself to show one.

colorWhenUndyed.label: Color when undyed
colorWhenUndyed.help: Color of the dyeable layers while the item is not dyed. Empty = no tint.

usePlayerTexture.label: Use player texture
usePlayerTexture.help: The elytra wings show the player’s own elytra or cape texture instead of this set’s texture.

settingsEquipmentLod.label: Equipment LOD
settingsEquipmentLod.description: A simpler equipment look for viewers farther away than a distance, e.g. 2D armor instead of a 3D model.

distance.label: Distance
distance.help: From this many blocks away, viewers see the far equipment (default 32).

settingsEquipmentPotionEffects.label: Equipment Potion Effects
settingsEquipmentPotionEffects.description: Potion effects while the item is in a slot. Of the same effect only the highest level applies.

slot.label: slot
slot.help: The slot or slot group (armor, hand, any) the item has to be in.

settingsFood.label: Food
settingsFood.description: Makes the item edible through the plugin instead of the food component. On 1.20.5+ servers the food component is the better choice.

settingsConsumeReplacement.label: Consume Replacement
settingsConsumeReplacement.description: The item a player gets back after consuming this one.

settingsCraftRemainder.label: Craft Remainder
settingsCraftRemainder.description: What stays in the crafting grid after crafting: an item, a fixed item and count, damage to the item itself, or a remainder per recipe.

settingsAllowedProjectiles.label: Allowed Projectiles
settingsAllowedProjectiles.description: Items a bow or crossbow can shoot.

settingsIngredientSubstitute.label: Ingredient Substitute
settingsIngredientSubstitute.description: Vanilla items this item can stand in for in recipes.

settingsCompostProbability.label: Compost Probability
settingsCompostProbability.description: Chance that the item raises the composter level (0–1).

settingsInvulnerable.label: Invulnerable
settingsInvulnerable.description: Damage causes a dropped item survives.

settingsKeepOnDeathChance.label: Keep On Death Chance
settingsKeepOnDeathChance.description: Chance that a player keeps the item on death (0–1).

settingsDestroyOnDeathChance.label: Destroy On Death Chance
settingsDestroyOnDeathChance.description: Chance that the item is destroyed on death (0–1).

settingsDropDisplay.label: Drop Display
settingsDropDisplay.description: Whether the name of the dropped item is shown above it, and what it shows.

settingsGlowColor.label: Glow Color
settingsGlowColor.description: The glow color of the dropped item.

settingsHatHeight.label: Hat Height
settingsHatHeight.description: How much the item raises the name tag when worn as a hat (needs CustomNameplates). Documented for CraftEngine versions after 26.9.

settingsTriggerAdvancement.label: Trigger Advancement
settingsTriggerAdvancement.description: Whether using the item triggers vanilla advancements. Read by CraftEngine 26.9, not documented on the wiki.

settingsProjectile.label: Projectile
settingsProjectile.description: Turns the thrown or shot item into a custom projectile (trident, arrow, snowball …) with its own look, sounds and hit behavior.

rotation.label: rotation
rotation.help: A quaternion x,y,z,w or Euler angles; depends on how the model is built.

damage.label: damage
damage.help: Base damage on hit; unset keeps the vanilla damage.

settingsAttributeModifiers.label: Custom Attribute Modifiers
settingsAttributeModifiers.description: Modifiers of the project's custom attributes (see Attributes) while the item is in a slot. Needs CraftEngine's attribute system.

settingsEquipmentSetPart.label: Equipment Set Piece
settingsEquipmentSetPart.description: Makes the item a piece of equipment sets (see Attributes) while it is in one of the slots. Needs CraftEngine's attribute system.

slots.label: slots
slots.help: The slots in which the item counts as a piece. Slot groups such as armor are not allowed here.

sets.label: sets
sets.help: The equipment sets the item counts for.

overrides.label: overrides
overrides.help: A different sound for these hit blocks or entities.
